context: Offline-seminar-sourced NIFTY intraday option automations, backtested against real 5-min/1-min NIFTY underlying (candle_cache.db) and real NIFTY option EOD settlement prices (options_nifty.db, 2020-2026). Intraday premium path is Black-Scholes, IV solved from the PREVIOUS trading day's real settle (no lookahead) -- see option_intraday_pricer.py. Real transaction costs (brokerage/STT/slippage) via nse_cost_model.py. Verdict requires a chronological 70/30 train/holdout split with n_holdout>=30 and a one-sample t-test on holdout P&L (p<0.05, mean>0) to PASS -- same bar as validation_harness.py applies to the other 11 rule strategies in validation_results.json.

bollinger_otm_reversal.description: 5-min close outside BB(20,2) -> buy 10-strike-OTM opposite-side option (fade)
bollinger_otm_reversal.reason: positive but not statistically distinguishable from noise (p=0.14)

sma20_atm_option.description: 5-min close vs SMA20 -> buy ATM CE/PE (fires ~99% of days -- not a selective filter)
sma20_atm_option.reason: SIGNIFICANTLY NEGATIVE on holdout (p=0.041) -- full-history gain was entirely carried by the earlier period; most recent 30% loses money

bollinger_otm_momentum.description: 5-min close outside BB(20,2) -> buy 1-strike-OTM same-side option (ride the breakout), 10 qty as stated
bollinger_otm_momentum.reason: positive but not significant (p=0.65) -- also fires on 99.3% of days, same selectivity issue as SMA20

adx_long_straddle.description: 1-min ADX(14)>50 before 10am -> buy ATM CE + ATM PE (long straddle), 10 lots each leg
adx_long_straddle.reason: 1-min candle history only covers 55 trading days (2026-05-25 onward) -- Sharpe 13 on 12 trades is the exact overfitting pattern that got supertrend_mtf rejected earlier; genuinely cannot be judged with data available

di_momentum_call.description: 5-min +DI(14)>25 AND Momentum(10)>0 -> buy ATM CE only (bull-only)
di_momentum_call.reason: negative on holdout, same decay pattern as sma20_atm_option though not statistically significant here

rolling_short_straddle.description: 10am sell ATM CE+PE, cycle exit at +-Rs15,000, 15min cooldown redeploy, one leg-level 20% SL re-entry/day, cycles until market close
rolling_short_straddle.holdout: not needed -- already clearly negative on full sample
rolling_short_straddle.reason: 58% of cycles (289/498) exit via the 20% leg-level stop -- gets whipsawed by intraday chop before theta decay or mean reversion can pay back a loss
